body: Two defects are reported in final grades, in two different modules, and both must be fixed. (1) weighted_mean in gradebook/averages.py divides by the wrong quantity: weighted_mean([80, 100], [3, 1]) returns 170.0, expected 85.0. Its docstring specifies sum(v * w) divided by the SUM of the weights; the empty and zero-total-weight cases already return 0.0 correctly. (2) letter_grade in gradebook/letters.py returns 'B' for a score of exactly 90, expected 'A': its docstring specifies 90 or above is an A (the 80/70/60 thresholds are already inclusive and correct). End to end, final_letter([90, 90], [1, 1]) should be 'A' and final_letter([80, 100], [3, 1]) should be 'B'. All existing tests pass and need no changes. Fix both defects and add regression tests covering both.
title: Fix weighted_mean denominator and the 90-point letter-grade boundary
